title: Physically in the Cao Camp, Heart with the Han
synopsis: Guan Yu agrees to work for Cao Cao, but his true allegiance lies elsewhere.

series.title: Famous Sayings and Stories from the Three Kingdoms

fullText.simplified:
身在曹营心在汉

    如果你读过“过五关，斩六将”这个故事，那现在的“身在曹营心在汉”就很好理解了。
    三国的时候，关羽和刘备被曹操打败后，两个人失散了。关羽带着刘备的妻子被曹操的人包围了。
    曹操很欣赏关羽，他请关羽为自己工作。他对关羽和刘备的妻子十分客气。关羽为了保护刘备的妻子，同意了曹操的请求。他和曹操说好：先为曹操工作，等以后知道刘备在哪儿了，就离开曹操去找刘备。
    关羽为曹操工作了一段时间，他完成了一些重要的工作，为曹操解决了几个大麻烦。曹操十分高兴，不但送给关羽很多钱、漂亮的衣服和很大的房子，还把当时全国最有名的马也送给了他。曹操经常请关羽吃饭喝酒聊天，一心一意地希望关羽能永远留下来。
    但是，关羽的心里一直想着自己的大哥刘备。他虽然人在曹操的军营里，但他的心一直在刘备那里。他帮曹操工作，只是因为曹操同意他“以后可以去找刘备”，并不是真的想为曹操工作。后来，关羽知道了刘备在什么地方，就马上带着刘备的妻子离开曹操，去找刘备了。
    这就是关羽“身在曹营心在汉”的故事，“曹”是曹操的意思，“汉”是大汉朝的意思。刘备是大汉朝皇室的后人，所以这个“汉”也代指刘备。现在，“身在曹营心在汉”已经是一个成语了。它的意思是：一个人虽然身体在这里，但他的心却在另外一个地方，这个人并不是真心想留在现在的地方。
    生活中有些情况，我们可以用这个成语。比如，有个人现在有一份工作。但这份工作的工资不高，也不是他喜欢的工作。为了生活，他要先做这份工作。同时，他每天都在网上看新的工作信息，心里一直想着怎么找一份更好的工作。这时候，你就可以说：“他真是‘身在曹营心在汉’啊！”
fullText.traditional:
身在曹營心在漢

    如果你讀過“過五關，斬六將”這個故事，那現在的“身在曹營心在漢”就很好理解了。
    三國的時候，關羽和劉備被曹操打敗後，兩個人失散了。關羽帶著劉備的妻子被曹操的人包圍了。
    曹操很欣賞關羽，他請關羽為自己工作。他對關羽和劉備的妻子十分客氣。關羽為了保護劉備的妻子，同意了曹操的請求。他和曹操說好：先為曹操工作，等以後知道劉備在哪兒了，就離開曹操去找劉備。
    關羽為曹操工作了一段時間，他完成了一些重要的工作，為曹操解決了幾個大麻煩。曹操十分高興，不但送給關羽很多錢、漂亮的衣服和很大的房子，還把當時全國最有名的馬也送給了他。曹操經常請關羽吃飯喝酒聊天，一心一意地希望關羽能永遠留下來。
    但是，關羽的心裡一直想著自己的大哥劉備。他雖然人在曹操的軍營裡，但他的心一直在劉備那裡。他幫曹操工作，只是因為曹操同意他“以後可以去找劉備”，並不是真的想為曹操工作。後來，關羽知道了劉備在什麼地方，就馬上帶著劉備的妻子離開曹操，去找劉備了。
    這就是關羽“身在曹營心在漢”的故事，“曹”是曹操的意思，“漢”是大漢朝的意思。劉備是大漢朝皇室的後人，所以這個“漢”也代指劉備。現在，“身在曹營心在漢”已經是一個成語了。它的意思是：一個人雖然身體在這裡，但他的心卻在另外一個地方，這個人並不是真心想留在現在的地方。
    生活中有些情況，我們可以用這個成語。比如，有個人現在有一份工作。但這份工作的工資不高，也不是他喜歡的工作。為了生活，他要先做這份工作。同時，他每天都在網上看新的工作信息，心裡一直想著怎麼找一份更好的工作。這時候，你就可以說：“他真是‘身在曹營心在漢’啊！”

sentences.simplified: 三国的时候，关羽和刘备被曹操打败后，两个人失散了。
sentences.traditional: 三國的時候，關羽和劉備被曹操打敗後，兩個人失散了。
sentences.pinyin: sān guó de shí hou guān yǔ hé liú bèi bèi cáo cāo dǎ bài hòu liǎng ge rén shī sàn le
sentences.english: During the Three Kingdoms period, after Guan Yu and Liu Bei were defeated by Cao Cao, the two were separated.

sentences.simplified: 关羽带着刘备的妻子被曹操的人包围了。
sentences.traditional: 關羽帶著劉備的妻子被曹操的人包圍了。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ dài zhe liú bèi de qī zi bèi cáo cāo de rén bāo wéi le
sentences.english: Guan Yu, escorting Liu Bei’s wives, was surrounded by Cao Cao’s men.

sentences.simplified: 曹操很欣赏关羽，他请关羽为自己工作。他对关羽和刘备的妻子十分客气。
sentences.traditional: 曹操很欣賞關羽，他請關羽為自己工作。他對關羽和劉備的妻子十分客氣。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hěn xīn shǎng guān yǔ tā qǐng guān yǔ wèi zì jǐ gōng zuò tā duì guān yǔ hé liú bèi de qī zi shí fēn kè qi
sentences.english: Cao Cao greatly admired Guan Yu and asked Guan Yu to work for him. He was very courteous toward Guan Yu and Liu Bei’s wives.

sentences.simplified: 关羽为了保护刘备的妻子，同意了曹操的请求。
sentences.traditional: 關羽為了保護劉備的妻子，同意了曹操的請求。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ wèi le bǎo hù liú bèi de qī zi tóng yì le cáo cāo de qǐng qiú
sentences.english: To protect Liu Bei’s wives, Guan Yu agreed to Cao Cao’s request.

sentences.simplified: 他和曹操说好：
sentences.traditional: 他和曹操說好：
sentences.pinyin: tā hé cáo cāo shuō hǎo
sentences.english: He made an agreement with Cao Cao:

sentences.simplified: 先为曹操工作，
sentences.traditional: 先為曹操工作，
sentences.pinyin: xiān wèi cáo cāo gōng zuò
sentences.english: He would work for Cao Cao for the time being.

sentences.simplified: 等以后知道刘备在哪儿了，就离开曹操去找刘备。
sentences.traditional: 等以後知道劉備在哪兒了，就離開曹操去找劉備。
sentences.pinyin: děng yǐ hòu zhī dào liú bèi zài nǎ'r le jiù lí kāi cáo cāo qù zhǎo liú bèi
sentences.english: But once he learned where Liu Bei was, he would leave Cao Cao  and go to find Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 关羽为曹操工作了一段时间，
sentences.traditional: 關羽為曹操工作了一段時間，
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ wèi cáo cāo gōng zuò le yí duàn shí jiān
sentences.english: Guan Yu worked for Cao Cao for a period of time.

sentences.simplified: 他完成了一些重要的工作，为曹操解决了几个大麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 他完成了一些重要的工作，為曹操解決了幾個大麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: tā wán chéng le yì xiē zhòng yào de gōng zuò wèi cáo cāo jiě jué le jǐ ge dà má fan
sentences.english: He completed some important tasks, solving several major problems for Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 曹操十分高兴，不但送给关羽很多钱、漂亮的衣服和很大的房子，
sentences.traditional: 曹操十分高興，不但送給關羽很多錢、漂亮的衣服和很大的房子，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo shí fēn gāo xìng bú dàn sòng gěi guān yǔ hěn duō qián piào liang de yī fu hé hěn dà de fáng zi
sentences.english: Cao Cao was very pleased and not only gave Guan Yu plenty of money, fine clothes, and a large house, ..

sentences.simplified: 还把当时全国最有名的马也送给了他。
sentences.traditional: 還把當時全國最有名的馬也送給了他。
sentences.pinyin: hái bǎ dāng shí quán guó zuì yǒu míng de mǎ yě sòng gěi le tā
sentences.english: .. but also gave him the most famous horse in the country at that time.

sentences.simplified: 曹操经常请关羽吃饭喝酒聊天，一心一意地希望关羽能永远留下来。
sentences.traditional: 曹操經常請關羽吃飯喝酒聊天，一心一意地希望關羽能永遠留下來。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo jīng cháng qǐng guān yǔ chī fàn hē jiǔ liáo tiān yì xīn yí yì de xī wàng guān yǔ néng yǒng yuǎn liú xià lai
sentences.english: Cao Cao often invited Guan Yu to dine, drink, and chat, wholeheartedly hoping that Guan Yu would stay forever.

sentences.simplified: 但是，关羽的心里一直想着自己的大哥刘备。
sentences.traditional: 但是，關羽的心裡一直想著自己的大哥劉備。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì guān yǔ de xīn lǐ yì zhí xiǎng zhe zì jǐ de dà gē liú bèi
sentences.english: However, in his heart, Guan Yu was always thinking of his eldest brother, Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 他虽然人在曹操的军营里，但他的心一直在刘备那里。
sentences.traditional: 他雖然人在曹操的軍營裡，但他的心一直在劉備那裡。
sentences.pinyin: tā suī rán rén zài cáo cāo de jūn yíng lǐ dàn tā de xīn yì zhí zài liú bèi nà lǐ
sentences.english: Although he was physically in Cao Cao’s camp, his heart was always with Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 他帮曹操工作，只是因为曹操同意他“以后可以去找刘备”，
sentences.traditional: 他幫曹操工作，只是因為曹操同意他“以後可以去找劉備”，
sentences.pinyin: tā bāng cáo cāo gōng zuò zhǐ shì yīn wèi cáo cāo tóng yì tā yǐ hòu kě yǐ qù zhǎo liú bèi
sentences.english: He worked for Cao Cao only because Cao Cao had agreed that he could “go to find Liu Bei later on” ..

sentences.simplified: 并不是真的想为曹操工作。
sentences.traditional: 並不是真的想為曹操工作。
sentences.pinyin: bìng bú shì zhēn de xiǎng wèi cáo cāo gōng zuò
sentences.english: .. and not because he truly wanted to work for Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 后来，关羽知道了刘备在什么地方，就马上带着刘备的妻子离开曹操，去找刘备了。
sentences.traditional: 後來，關羽知道了劉備在什麼地方，就馬上帶著劉備的妻子離開曹操，去找劉備了。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái guān yǔ zhī dào le liú bèi zài shén me dì fang jiù mǎ shàng dài zhe liú bèi de qī zi lí kāi cáo cāo qù zhǎo liú bèi le
sentences.english: Later, when Guan Yu found out where Liu Bei was, he immediately left Cao Cao, taking Liu Bei’s wives with him to go and find Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 这就是关羽“身在曹营心在汉”的故事，
sentences.traditional: 這就是關羽“身在曹營心在漢”的故事，
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì guān yǔ shēn zài cáo yíng xīn zài hàn de gù shi
sentences.english: This is the story of Guan Yu being “physically in the Cao camp but having his heart with the Han”.

sentences.simplified: “曹”是曹操的意思，“汉”是大汉朝的意思。
sentences.traditional: “曹”是曹操的意思，“漢”是大漢朝的意思。
sentences.pinyin: cáo shì cáo cāo de yì si hàn shì dà hàn cháo de yì si
sentences.english: “Cao” refers to Cao Cao, and “Han” refers to the Han dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 刘备是大汉朝皇室的后人，所以这个“汉”也代指刘备。
sentences.traditional: 劉備是大漢朝皇室的後人，所以這個“漢”也代指劉備。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi shì dà hàn cháo huáng shì de hòu rén suǒ yǐ zhè ge hàn yě dài zhǐ liú bèi
sentences.english: Liu Bei was a descendant of the imperial family of the Han dynasty, so here “Han” also refers to Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 现在，“身在曹营心在汉”已经是一个成语了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，“身在曹營心在漢”已經是一個成語了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài shēn zài cáo yíng xīn zài hàn yǐ jīng shì yí ge chéng yǔ le
sentences.english: Today, “physically in the Cao camp, heart with the Han” has become an idiom.

sentences.simplified: 它的意思是：一个人虽然身体在这里，但他的心却在另外一个地方，
sentences.traditional: 它的意思是：一個人雖然身體在這裡，但他的心卻在另外一個地方，
sentences.pinyin: tā de yì si shì yí ge rén suī rán shēn tǐ zài zhè lǐ dàn tā de xīn què zài lìng wài yí ge dì fang
sentences.english: It means that although a person is physically in one place, their heart is in another.

sentences.simplified: 这个人并不是真心想留在现在的地方。
sentences.traditional: 這個人並不是真心想留在現在的地方。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rén bìng bú shì zhēn xīn xiǎng liú zài xiàn zài de dì fang
sentences.english: This person doesn’t truly want to stay where they currently are.

sentences.simplified: 生活中有些情况，我们可以用这个成语。
sentences.traditional: 生活中有些情況，我們可以用這個成語。
sentences.pinyin: shēng huó zhōng yǒu xiē qíng kuàng wǒ men kě yǐ yòng zhè ge chéng yǔ
sentences.english: In everyday life, there are some situations where we can use this idiom.

sentences.simplified: 比如，有个人现在有一份工作。但这份工作的工资不高，也不是他喜欢的工作。
sentences.traditional: 比如，有個人現在有一份工作。但這份工作的工資不高，也不是他喜歡的工作。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú yǒu ge rén xiàn zài yǒu yí fèn gōng zuò dàn zhè fèn gōng zuò de gōng zī bù gāo yě bú shì tā xǐ huan de gōng zuò
sentences.english: For example, someone might have a job right now, but the salary is not high, and it’s also not a job they like.

sentences.simplified: 为了生活，他要先做这份工作。
sentences.traditional: 為了生活，他要先做這份工作。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le shēng huó tā yào xiān zuò zhè fèn gōng zuò
sentences.english: To make a living, they have to keep doing this job for now.

sentences.simplified: 同时，他每天都在网上看新的工作信息，
sentences.traditional: 同時，他每天都在網上看新的工作信息，
sentences.pinyin: tóng shí tā měi tiān dōu zài wǎng shang kàn xīn de gōng zuò xìn xī
sentences.english: In the meantime, they are looking online for new job opportunities every day, ..

sentences.simplified: 心里一直想着怎么找一份更好的工作。
sentences.traditional: 心裡一直想著怎麼找一份更好的工作。
sentences.pinyin: xīn lǐ yì zhí xiǎng zhe zěn me zhǎo yí fèn gèng hǎo de gōng zuò
sentences.english: .. always thinking about how they can find a better job.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，你就可以说：“他真是‘身在曹营心在汉’啊！”
sentences.traditional: 這時候，你就可以說：“他真是‘身在曹營心在漢’啊！”
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou nǐ jiù kě yǐ shuō tā zhēn shi shēn zài cáo yíng xīn zài hàn a
sentences.english: At this point, you could say, “They truly are ‘physically in the Cao Camp, heart with the Han’!”

sentence_translations: Physically in the Cao Camp, Heart with the Han
If you read the story “Cross Five Passes and Slay Six Generals”, ..
.. then this phrase “physically in the Cao camp, heart with the Han” should be easy to understand.
During the Three Kingdoms period, after Guan Yu and Liu Bei were defeated by Cao Cao, the two were separated.
Guan Yu, escorting Liu Bei’s wives, was surrounded by Cao Cao’s men.
Cao Cao greatly admired Guan Yu and asked Guan Yu to work for him. He was very courteous toward Guan Yu and Liu Bei’s wives.
To protect Liu Bei’s wives, Guan Yu agreed to Cao Cao’s request.
He made an agreement with Cao Cao:
He would work for Cao Cao for the time being.
But once he learned where Liu Bei was, he would leave Cao Cao  and go to find Liu Bei.
Guan Yu worked for Cao Cao for a period of time.
He completed some important tasks, solving several major problems for Cao Cao.
Cao Cao was very pleased and not only gave Guan Yu plenty of money, fine clothes, and a large house, ..
.. but also gave him the most famous horse in the country at that time.
Cao Cao often invited Guan Yu to dine, drink, and chat, wholeheartedly hoping that Guan Yu would stay forever.
However, in his heart, Guan Yu was always thinking of his eldest brother, Liu Bei.
Although he was physically in Cao Cao’s camp, his heart was always with Liu Bei.
He worked for Cao Cao only because Cao Cao had agreed that he could “go to find Liu Bei later on” ..
.. and not because he truly wanted to work for Cao Cao.
Later, when Guan Yu found out where Liu Bei was, he immediately left Cao Cao, taking Liu Bei’s wives with him to go and find Liu Bei.
This is the story of Guan Yu being “physically in the Cao camp but having his heart with the Han”.
“Cao” refers to Cao Cao, and “Han” refers to the Han dynasty.
Liu Bei was a descendant of the imperial family of the Han dynasty, so here “Han” also refers to Liu Bei.
Today, “physically in the Cao camp, heart with the Han” has become an idiom.
It means that although a person is physically in one place, their heart is in another.
This person doesn’t truly want to stay where they currently are.
In everyday life, there are some situations where we can use this idiom.
For example, someone might have a job right now, but the salary is not high, and it’s also not a job they like.
To make a living, they have to keep doing this job for now.
In the meantime, they are looking online for new job opportunities every day, ..
.. always thinking about how they can find a better job.
At this point, you could say, “They truly are ‘physically in the Cao Camp, heart with the Han’!”
